_comment: Width allowances (px, FONT_NORMAL measure) for batch text-b. Each value verified against the window template / print call cited in the matching _why entry.
_why src/data/text/ribbon_descriptions.h: PrintRibbonNameAndDescription (pokenav_ribbons_summary.c) prints each of the 2 lines with AddTextPrinterParameterized3(ribbonCountWindowId, FONT_NORMAL, x=0); sRibbonCountWindowTemplate width 16 tiles = 128 px.
_why src/pokenav_ribbons_summary.c:gText: PrintCurrentMonRibbonCount: FONT_NORMAL x=0 in sRibbonCountWindowTemplate (16 tiles = 128 px); {DYNAMIC 0} is at most 2 digits, 110 leaves >= 18 px for them.
_why src/data/lilycove_lady.h: All strings are copied into gStringVar1/2 (BufferFavorLadyRequest, BufferContestLadyCategoryAndMonName) and only shown inside field message boxes in data/scripts/lilycove_lady.inc, whose STR_VAR lines were validated with the 60 px STR_VAR assumption and are all short (longest STR_VAR line < 150 px in a 208+ px box). monName also goes to tv contestLady.nickname[VANILLA_POKEMON_NAME_LENGTH+1] via StringCopy: all names kept <= 8 bytes.
_why src/berry_tag_screen.c:sText_SizeSl: PrintBerrySize/PrintBerryFirmness print the label at x=0 in WIN_SIZE_FIRM and the value at x=0x28 (40 px); labels must stay < 40 px.
_why sBerryFirmnessStrings: PrintBerryFirmness: FONT_NORMAL at x=0x28 (40) in WIN_SIZE_FIRM, width 18 tiles = 144 px -> 104 px available.
_why src/berry_tag_screen.c:sText_BerryT: AddBerryTagTextToBg0: centered with GetStringCenterAlignXOffset(FONT_NORMAL, .., 0x40) in WIN_BERRY_TAG, width 8 tiles = 64 px.
_why src/tv.c:sText_Good: DoTVShow3CheersForPokeblocks copies these into gStringVar2, shown via ShowFieldMessage in gTV3CheersForPokeblocksText01/03 (data/text/tv.inc); the script validator budgets {STR_VAR_2} at 10 chars x 6 = 60 px.
_why src/berry_fix_program.c:sText_Berry: BerryFix_SetScene: FONT_NORMAL, centered in WIN_TITLE, width 26 tiles = 208 px.
_why src/berry_fix_program.c:sText_RubyS: Printed with FONT_SMALL (68 px real) centered in WIN_TURN_OFF_TITLE (14 tiles = 112 px) and WIN_GAME_NAMES (30 tiles); FONT_NORMAL measure capped at 100.
_why src/berry_fix_program.c body: BerryFix_SetScene: AddTextPrinterParameterized3(WIN_MSG_BODY, FONT_NORMAL, x=0); WIN_MSG_BODY width 28 tiles = 224 px, height 8 tiles = 4 lines (line counts kept).
_why src/pokenav_match_call_gfx.c:gText_: PrintMatchCallInfoLabel: FONT_NARROW at x=2 in sMatchCallInfoBoxWindowTemplate (11 tiles = 88 px); the number is on its own row below.
PrintTrainerIsCloseBy: FONT_NORMAL x=0 in sCallMsgBoxWindowTemplate (28 tiles = 224 px); capped at the 192 px PokéNav budget.
PrintMatchCallLocation: FONT_NARROW centered in 88 px (sMatchCallLocationWindowTemplate, 11 tiles).
_why sMatchCallOptionTexts: PrintMatchCallSelectionOptions: FONT_NARROW at x=16 in sMatchCallInfoBoxWindowTemplate (88 px) -> 72 px.
_why src/pokenav_match_call_list.c:gText: Returned by GetMatchCallMessageText and printed by PrintMatchCallMessage (pokenav_match_call_gfx.c): FONT_NORMAL x=32 in sCallMsgBoxWindowTemplate (224 px) -> 192 px.
_why src/lilycove_lady.c:BufferQuizAutho: StringCopy_PlayerName into gStringVar1 (PLAYER_NAME_LENGTH 7 chars; 'Signora' = 7); shown as {STR_VAR_1} in lilycove_lady.inc where a player name is budgeted 7 x 6 = 42 px.
